status_matrix.recommendation: Geometric SMCI migration and legacy product audit
status_matrix.evidence: Cell-level GM, shared-scale deltas, and product audit are regenerated.
status_matrix.final_decision: Primary reporting scale is equal-weight geometric mean.

status_matrix.recommendation: Bruno CCS, NPT, coverage, inequality, and local-access robustness
status_matrix.evidence: All requested outputs are generated at 600/800/1000/1200 m.
status_matrix.remaining_blocker: K=5 uses a declared 20-minute missing-category penalty because only four observed POI categories exist.
status_matrix.final_decision: Supplementary robustness; primary NAI remains 800 m.

status_matrix.recommendation: Interactive map correctness, controls, layers, and browser smoke test
status_matrix.evidence: One embedded dataset, shared A/B bounds, selected-cell comparison, and responsive controls pass tests.
status_matrix.remaining_blocker: Map is an analytical interface, not external field validation.
status_matrix.final_decision: Default map reports the GM primary specification.

status_matrix.recommendation: Shifted-square and equal-area hexagon grid robustness
status_matrix.evidence: All four alternate grids were recomputed and compared.
status_matrix.final_decision: Primary 250 m square grid remains the reporting grid.

status_matrix.recommendation: Sensitivity consolidation and scenario uncertainty envelope
status_matrix.remaining_blocker: Envelope is not a confidence interval.
status_matrix.final_decision: Sensitivity results use the canonical 800 m/RAC_time/GM spec.

status_matrix.remaining_blocker: Grades are an audit layer, not an SMCI component.
status_matrix.final_decision: No new index component was introduced.

status_matrix.recommendation: Reliability, generalized-cost, and mixed-traffic RAC contracts
status_matrix.evidence: Schemas refuse to run without required observed inputs.
status_matrix.remaining_blocker: Observed reliability, cost, and friction data are absent.

status_matrix.evidence: Ten manually audited Android motorcycle OD pairs are recomputed on the production Network D graph.
status_matrix.remaining_blocker: The 10-pair consumer-app check validates Network D travel times only; it is not overall external validation.
status_matrix.final_decision: The study does not claim SMCI, typology, or causal external validation.

status_matrix.evidence: Strict metrics, observed-opportunity audit, and reproducible CBD distances are generated.
status_matrix.remaining_blocker: Current Tay Mo core is 18.6% closer to Hoan Kiem than Ocean Park, exceeding the preregistered +/-15% gate.
status_matrix.final_decision: Do not promote this pair; select a new control core or explicitly update the protocol.

status_matrix.remaining_blocker: Historical decision-log values remain dated context only.
status_matrix.final_decision: Semantic checks cover SMCI/RAC/NAI and data-status claims.
